                      warning = FALSE,

# Data
Load libraries
```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, # spatial
               here, 
               tidyverse, 
               rio, # for importing
               table1 # make table1
               )
```

Read in shapefiles
```{r}
## Read in case shapefile - TIRS_SINAVE_22_23
sus <- st_read(dsn = here("data"), 
                 layer = "TIRS_SINAVE_22_23")
## Cluster shapefile
clusters <- st_read(dsn = here("data"),
                    layer = "Cluster final 2021 actualizado")
```

## Some Cleaning
Only actual cases
```{r}
cases <- sus %>% filter(Diagnosis != "Negativo")
```

# Map
By source
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = clusters, linewidth = 0.05, aes(fill = as.factor(TIRS)),
          alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_sf(data = cases, size = 0.75, stroke = 0,
          aes(color = as.factor(Source))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ivory4", "dodgerblue4"), 
                    name = "TIRS", labels = c("No", "Yes")) + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("cadetblue3", "coral2"), 
                    name = "Source", labels = c("TIRS", "SINAVE")) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("cases_source.pdf")
```
